dish: farm soft-serve and rice-flour roll cake
n: Niseko Takahashi Farm Milk Kobo (ニセコ高橋牧場 ミルク工房)
address: Niseko, Abuta District, Hokkaido, Japan (near Niseko Village ski resort)
w: The dairy farm's own sweets shop facing Mount Yōtei — soft-serve, rice-flour roll cake and drinking yogurt from the farm's milk, with a vegetable-buffet restaurant and cheese workshop alongside.

dish: crab kaiseki — taraba, zuwai and kegani, ~30 crab dishes
n: Kani Ryōri Hyōsetsu no Mon (蟹料理の店 氷雪の門)
w: Sapporo's oldest crab specialist — king, snow and hairy crab as sashimi, charcoal-grilled, shabu-shabu and tempura.

n: Sapporo Kani Honke Ekimae Honten (札幌かに本家 札幌駅前本店)
address: Near JR Sapporo Station, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: Crab bought direct at the fishing grounds and served at fair prices in set courses, steps from Sapporo Station.

n: Sushi Zen Honten (すし善 本店)
w: The grand old name in Sapporo sushi — an all-hinoki house with several counters and private rooms, Hokkaido fish handled with Edomae technique.
